title: DECISION CARD  ex18_a3_mes_win  A3 expiry-Friday short  MES leg  2019-10-18 09:30
decision:
Rule: today 2019-10-18 is the monthly options expiry (Fri 2019-10-18)  ->  SHORT 1 MES at the 09:30 mark 2,991.75,
    cover at the 16:00 mark, no stop
drivers:
Only the calendar decides: no price, trend, VWAP or EMA is read. The trade is the same every month (also on MNQ and MYM); the idea is that option-
    hedging flows that lift prices into the morning settlement fade during the day.
A3 MES leg overall (v3/out/trades/A3.parquet): 181 trades, mean +16.26 $, 54% winners.
outcome:
OUTCOME: cover 2,985.25 at 16:00 -> +29.00 $ per micro after $3.50 costs (+6.50 pts)  =  RIGHT.  Whole basket that
    day: +251.50 $
why: As the expiry idea expects, MES drifted down through the day: 2,991.75 at 09:30 to 2,985.25 at 16:00, so the short earned +29.00 $.
notes:
Edge vs an ordinary day: +29.00 $ minus C1 -10.83 $ = +39.83 $ (stored d_c1 +38.85 uses the 999-draw c1 -9.85). Prices recomputed from 1-minute bars and matched to
    sessions_ES.parquet and A3.parquet.

C1 here = exact average over ALL same-year sessions with both prices; the stored c1 is the average of 999 random draws from those sessions, so the two differ by sampling
